speedPath.name: Speed data path
speedPath.hint: Path to the actor's speed, where {action} is replaced by the token's movement action (e.g. system.attributes.movement.{action}). Leave blank to use the built-in default for this game system.

actionMap.name: Movement action mapping
actionMap.hint: Optional comma-separated overrides mapping core movement actions to the system's speed keys, e.g. walk=land, fly=fly.

showDash.name: Show dash range
showDash.hint: Also highlight the spaces reachable with a dash (extra move) in a second color.

dashMultiplier.name: Dash multiplier
dashMultiplier.hint: The total movement, as a multiple of speed, that a dash allows. 2 means double speed.

colorMove.name: Move color
colorMove.hint: Highlight color for spaces reachable with a normal move.

colorDash.name: Dash color
colorDash.hint: Highlight color for spaces reachable only with a dash.

showDistance.name: Show distances
showDistance.hint: Label each highlighted space with the cumulative movement cost to reach it, including difficult terrain.

debug.name: Enable debug console messages
debug.hint: If enabled, detailed debug messages will output to the console.
